1: Paul left Titus in Crete to appoint elders in every town. A bishop must be blameless, hospitable, self-controlled and able to teach sound doctrine and correct those who contradict it.
From the beginning the Church had ordained leaders responsible for guarding the faith.
2: Titus is to teach older men, older women, young people and servants how to live well. The grace of God has appeared, training us to give up ungodliness and to live upright lives while we wait for our blessed hope.
Grace teaches as well as forgives. Good lives make the Gospel attractive.
3: Be obedient to rulers and gentle to all. We too were once foolish, but God saved us, not because of deeds we had done but by his mercy, through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
"The washing of rebirth" is baptism. Those who believe should be careful to devote themselves to good works.
